description: Defines the OrderTotalItem class representing an item with a price and code in an order, implementing Serializable for object serialization.

classes.name: OrderTotalItem
classes.description: A model class representing an item in an order, with properties for item price and item code.

methods.name: setItemPrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the item.

methods.name: getItemPrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the item.

methods.name: setItemCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifying the item.

methods.name: getItemCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the item.
